name: flashcards
description: Turn notes, a textbook page, or a topic into flashcards in aitutors.me's own format — atomic fronts, no hint-leak, the right card kind for the material — output as JSON ready to import at aitutors.me/study/cards/new/import.

interface.shortDescription: Author flashcards in aitutors.me's own format, ready to import
interface.longDescription: Teaches an LLM to turn source material into flashcards that pass aitutors.me's own QA gate on the first try: atomic single-fact fronts, no hint-leak, the right card kind (basic, basic_reversed, type_in, cloze, cloze_multi) for the material. Format and QA only — no tutoring or curriculum logic. Output is one JSON block, ready to paste at aitutors.me/study/cards/new/import; no API key required.
defaultPrompt: flashcards: turn this page of notes into cards for KS3 biology
flashcards: make basic_reversed cards from this vocab list, split into batches of 8
flashcards: I have a topic, no notes — make me a set on the water cycle
